name: focustrace
description: Local-first WCAG 2.2 accessibility rule engine and runtime focus debugger.

scripts.hardening:test: vitest run tests/scan.fixtures.test.ts tests/qa-hardening.test.ts tests/scan-query-budget.test.ts tests/target-size.test.ts tests/specialized-accessible-names.test.ts tests/aria-role-state-relationships.test.ts tests/table-relationships.test.ts tests/embedded-content.test.ts tests/viewport-visual.test.ts tests/keyboard-navigation-motion.test.ts
scripts.quality:validate: npm run rules:validate && npm run conformance:validate && npm run hardening:test && npm run i18n:validate && npm run deadcode:validate && npm run coverage:critical
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings entrypoints lib shared cli integrations examples tests tools playwright.config.ts playwright.focustrace-example.config.ts vitest.config.ts wxt.config.ts vite.cli.browser.config.ts vite.cli.node.config.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e && npm run test:e2e
scripts.release:check: npm run standards:validate && npm run axe:validate && npm run capabilities:validate && npm run quality:validate && npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:clean && npm run build && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox && npm run validate:builds && npm run bundle:validate
scripts.release:check:full: npm run release:check && npm run e2e && npm run test:e2e -- --config=playwright.focustrace-example.config.ts
